author: mark
text:
Alignment gate: dispatch built-in coherent with spec docs.

ARCH §2.5 (dispatch primitive): the tool collapses onto the existing
primitive — spawns through §3.4's `lernie dispatch <role>`, returns
the §2.5 "Async work uses handles" shape `{status: in_progress,
handle}`. No parallel path.

ARCH §3.3 (stdio contract): tool uses the stdin/stdout/stderr/exit
contract verbatim. New env-var bullet documents `LERNIE_CONV_REPO`
+ `LERNIE_CONV_BRANCH` injection — mirrors §4.4's adapter env-var
convention; tools that don't need it ignore it.

ARCH §3.4 (CLI as control plane): dispatch tool re-enters the binary
as `lernie dispatch <role>` rather than calling `worker::run`
in-process — preserves the "everyone uses the front door" rule.

ARCH §4.3 (soul resolution): validates `<conv-repo>/souls/<role>.md`
per §4.3, no path override.

PRINCIPLES "Symmetry of dispatch", "Tools return synchronously; async
rides on handles", "Single source of truth" (handle is git's branch
ref — no sidecar map): all upheld.

TAXONOMY: no new terms of art coined.
